page.title: Import statement
page.description: CSV and XLSX · up to 10 MB and 50,000 rows

wizard.uploadFailed: Couldn’t upload the file. Check your connection and try again.
wizard.ambiguousHeaders: The headers are ambiguous. Use the column wizard.
wizard.fileDescription: The original file is held in memory only while reading it. Only normalised rows are saved in your history.
wizard.experimental: Experimental profile. The 2026 format has not been verified against a sample. Check signs, dates, statuses and currencies.
wizard.defaultAccount: Account for rows without an account name
wizard.fallbackCurrency: Currency if no column is present (ISO)
wizard.assumePosted: Treat rows without a status as posted (I have checked the statement)
wizard.saveProfile: Save settings as a new household profile (optional)
wizard.minorUnitsHint: Whole units for JPY/KRW, thousandths for BHD.
wizard.currencyHint: There is no automatic conversion. Each row’s currency must match the selected account. New accounts are not created.
wizard.inspection: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · sheets: {sheets}. Check the headers and first rows.

preview.categoryApplied: Category applied. The rule will be saved when you import.
preview.noResponse: No response received. Open this batch again. It is safe to confirm it again.
preview.title: Review transactions
preview.totalsHint: Totals include selected new transactions and planned transactions to confirm. Skipped rows, links to existing transactions and selected transfers do not increase income or expenses.
preview.dateHint: The booking date is used when present; otherwise the transaction date is used. The account’s opening balance should be from the start of the period.
preview.balancesHint: Balances are checked between consecutive rows in the file.
preview.noBalances: Reconciliation needs two consecutive balances for an account. This file does not have enough.
preview.acknowledge: I have checked the balance difference
preview.period: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · {from}{range, select, yes { — {to}} other {}}
preview.toRecord: To record · {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}
preview.missingCategory: {count, plural, one {# row has no category} other {# rows have no category}}. Choose a category or skip these rows.

result.description: The import result is saved in your history.
result.linked: {count, plural, one {# row linked to existing transactions} other {# rows linked to existing transactions}}

undo.title: Undo import?
undo.description: Created transactions will be removed and planned transactions will return to their previous amounts and dates. Transactions edited or linked to another batch prevent the entire undo.

commit.title: Import transactions?
commit.description: Selected transactions will be recorded. Duplicates and skipped rows do not create transactions.
commit.transactions: Import {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}

row.title: Statement row
row.allowDuplicate: This is a separate purchase: create it despite the match

similar.title: Apply to similar rows?
similar.prompt: Apply “{category}” to {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} matching “{description}” and remember?
similar.description: Apply category “{category}” to {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} matching “{description}”. The rule for future imports will be saved when you confirm this batch.

bulk.title: Category for selected rows
bulk.description: Applies to new transactions of the matching type. Duplicates, transfers and planned transactions keep their decisions.

history.title: Import history
history.description: The latest 100 batches. Reopen a draft to continue.
history.emptyDescription: Choose a file, review the preview and confirm the import.

rule.saved: Rule saved. It will apply to the next preview.
rule.create: Create a category rule with conditions
rule.title: Category rule
rule.description: For future imports in this household.
rule.hint: All conditions must match. The rule applies to the selected currency. RE2 does not support lookaround or backreferences. Generate a new preview after saving.

notices.unsupportedCurrency: Unsupported currency. Enter an ISO currency code.
notices.excelDate: This Excel number is not marked as a date. Set its date format in the workbook.
notices.isoDate: Expected a date in YYYY-MM-DD format
notices.fullYear: Expected a date with a four-digit year
notices.requiredCurrency: Every row in this profile must include a transaction currency
notices.separateAmounts: Fill in only one non-negative amount: income or expense
notices.unsignedAmount: Use an unsigned amount with a direction column
notices.zeroAmount: A zero amount cannot create a transaction
notices.sameCurrencyTransfer: Amounts sent and received must match for transfers in the same currency
notices.pending: The bank has not posted this transaction yet. Import it later.
notices.rejected: The bank rejected this transaction. This row will be skipped.
notices.unknownStatus: The status does not confirm a posted transaction. This row can only be skipped.
notices.experimental: Experimental profile: check the sign, status and booking date
notices.noConversion: Unsupported currency. There is no automatic conversion.
notices.columnCount: Column count does not match the header
notices.loanAccount: For a loan account statement, use Loans to preserve the payment breakdown.
notices.transferDestination: Check the destination account and amount received
notices.repeatedFile: This file has already been imported. Check for duplicates. Repeated files are skipped by default.
notices.bankExperimental: T-Bank: experimental profile. The bank’s current format has not been verified. Check the preview.
notices.effectiveDate: The booking date is used when present; otherwise the transaction date is used. The opening balance should be from the start of the imported period.
notices.loanPayment: Matches a loan payment. This row is excluded. Confirm the full payment in Loans to record principal and interest without duplicates.
notices.repeatedId: Repeated stable bank ID in this file
notices.multiplePlanned: Several planned transactions match. Choose one manually.
notices.regexLength: Regular expressions must be between 1 and 200 characters
notices.currencyMismatch: Row currency {currency} does not match account currency {accountCurrency}
notices.exportPlanned: BestBudget export: keep Planned status without posting
notices.exportSkipped: BestBudget export: keep Skipped status without posting
notices.directions: Income and expense values must be different
